title: Distorted vocal

complaints.says: My voice sounds crunchy and distorted in the speakers.

win.label: Leader vocal clean in the mains
win.hint: Turn Ch 1's gain down (Fat Channel) to about 45 dB.

win.label: Ch 1 meter in the green
win.hint: Set Ch 1's gain so its meter sits in the green: about 45 dB.

hints: Select Ch 1 and look at its meter. Turning the fader down won't help if it's already overloaded before the fader.
cause: Ch 1's preamp gain was far too high, so the signal clipped before it reached the fader.
lesson: Gain is set once, at the preamp, so the meter sits in the green. Faders set the balance. A distorted signal can't be fixed with the fader.
